answer_1.quote: Our work focuses primarily on parameter-modifying methods, which inherently face greater challenges in controlling ripple effects compared to their parameter-preserving counterparts. These methods typically employ specialized loss functions and optimization constraints to control such ripple effects.
answer_1.outputs: edited knowledge in large language models to maintain logical consistency

answer_2.quote: The original dataset measures ripple effects through six metrics: Logical Generalization (LG), Compositionality I (CI), Compositionality II (CII), Subject Aliasing (SA), Forgetfulness (FF) 1 , and Relation Specificity (RS).
